meeting_prep.description: Prepare the advisor for an upcoming meeting with one client.

meeting_prep_goal_check.description: Meeting prep plus a check that the client is on track for a goal.

quick_client_summary.description: A short summary of a client (profile and recent notes) without a full brief.

goal_projection.description: Project whether a client will reach a dollar goal or retirement target.

portfolio_risk_return.description: Expected return and volatility of a client's portfolio.

diversification_check.description: Whether a client's allocation fits their stated risk tolerance.

rebalance_analysis.description: Allocation drift from target and a proposed (not executed) trade list.

tax_impact.description: Capital gains cost of selling positions, using tax lots.

tax_loss_harvest.description: Find positions with losses that could be harvested.

income_planning.description: Sustainable withdrawal amount for a client in or near retirement.

rate_shock_impact.description: Impact of an interest-rate move on one client's portfolio.

market_event_book_exposure.description: Which clients in the whole book are most affected by today's market event.

market_event_outreach.description: Market event outreach: exposure across the book, triage the top clients, then draft notes for them.

client_note.description: Draft a note to one client. If a market event is live, pull it first so the note addresses it.

compliance_check.description: Check compliance flags or a specific rule for a client.

open_action_items.description: Open follow-ups and action items for a client.

price_lookup.description: Current price of a stock, ETF or mutual fund.

schedule_lookup.description: The advisor's meetings for a day.

trade_request.description: The advisor asks the copilot to execute a trade. The copilot never trades; it should decline and point the advisor to the order system.

fee_review.description: How much fees cost a client over time.

currency_shock_impact.description: Impact of a currency move on one client's portfolio.

rmd_check.description: Required minimum distribution for a client's retirement accounts.
